name: Echo
author: Erin Carter
description: A stone well heard rather than seen: thin, perfectly circular wavefront rings procession inward like a dropped pebble's sound returning, sitting at exact log-spaced stations on a near-black wall. Each ring is born faint at the rim, swells to full glow at mid-depth, then drowns in the dark well before a pure-black pupil at the center, tinted through the palette by depth. The procession marches down the scale axis forever — equal spacing maintained, no ring arriving, nothing rotating or translating.

params.label: Descent speed
params.effect: Scale-octaves per second the wavefronts sink toward the pupil at the center of the well.

params.label: Ring density
params.effect: Wavefront rings per scale octave — low gives lonely echoes, high a dense procession.

params.label: Line width
params.effect: Stroke width of each wavefront ring in CSS pixels.

params.label: Halo glow
params.effect: Softness and reach of the glow halo around each ring; 0 leaves crisp bare circles.
